answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must lock cryptographic stake into an opal vault and execute irreversible burning for consensus votes. Rather than broadcasting an unverified whisper across peers, identity validation requires quadratic staking curves where aggregate burn costs scale as O(n^2), imposing superlinear economic friction.
